text: A [Pulse Resonator](pulse_resonator) and a [Ley Collector](ley_collector) made one. Stand it at the heart of a **Heart Star**, all six totem voices around it, and it burns three fuels at once and raises **six ley lines** out into the world.
It stores **200,000 Pulse**, about 45 seconds of its best, which it keeps when you break it.

pages.title: The Heart Star
text: Set the heart on a 3x3 of **Anchor Stones**, then stand one Resonance Totem of **each** voice **five blocks** out, on the heart's own level. Fire and Water face each other across the heart on one line. Earth and Air, and Spirit and Loom, face each other on the slants: three blocks across and four along.
Any facing works. Until every piece is in place the heart is silent. Crouch and right-click it with this book to hear what is missing; the missing places sparkle in the world.

pages.title: The Heart Star
pages.text: Anchor Stones under the heart; a totem of every voice five blocks out.

pages.title: Three fuels
text: Right-click the heart to open it. Each fuel has its own intake:
- **Resonator crystals** go in the crystal slot: Echo Shard, Attuned Echo, Bound Echo or Resonant Core. One burns **15, 12, 10 or 8 minutes**: a better crystal sings louder and burns faster.

- Any **creature reagent** goes in the reagent slot. A plain one burns **2 minutes**; one with a **Thread** (see [Reagents](reagents)) burns hotter and faster: **90, 60 or 40 seconds** for Thread I, II or III.
- **Water** fills an 8,000 mB tank from a bucket, a pipe or a fluid relay plate. It burns fastest of the three: **200 mB a second**, a bucket every five seconds.
Hoppers and relays can feed both slots; nothing comes back out. Fuel is only spent on seconds that deliver Pulse, so a full heart rests.

pages.title: What it makes
text: Each second the heart sings six times the Resonator's song: **6 x voices x (voices + 2)**, times what the burning fuels are worth, over four. A crystal is worth what it is worth in a Resonator (**4, 6, 8 or 12**), a plain reagent **4** and a reagent of Thread I, II or III **6, 9 or 12**, and water **2**. Its voices are the answered totems of the six.

To that it adds the ley's share: **12 Pulse a second for each point** of ley strength at the heart, with six voices answering. The heart reads the land and the planet's lines its totems pull in, but not its own six.
Then the harmony: two kinds of fuel burning together multiply it all by **1.25**, all three by **1.5**. With nothing burning it makes nothing. Each [rank](machine_ranks) of the heart adds **15%**.

pages.title: Quality is the lever
text: With six voices answering:
- An Echo Shard, a plain reagent and water make **1,080 to 1,368 Pulse a second**, from a bare site to a perfect one.
- A Bound Echo, a Thread II reagent and water on a middling site (ley 8) make about **2,200**.
- A Resonant Core, a Thread III reagent and water on a perfect site make **3,096**; a Manifested heart makes **4,489 Pulse a second**.
A Resonant Core Resonator and a perfect Ley Collector side by side make 168.

pages.title: What it costs
text: Better fuel sings louder and burns faster. An hour of a plain heart (Echo Shard, plain reagents, water) burns **4 Echo Shards, 30 reagents and 720 buckets of water**.
An hour at its best burns **7.5 Resonant Cores, 90 Thread III reagents** and the same 720 buckets. One Exalted familiar brushed every minute sheds 120 Thread III reagents an hour.
Fuel is only spent on seconds that deliver Pulse: a full heart rests until something draws on it.

pages.title: Six ley lines
text: While the star is whole the heart raises **six ley lines**, one in each totem's colour, running from the heart out through its totem and on for **64 blocks** into the world. They are real lines: the [Ley Lens](ley_lens) draws them, and a [Ley Collector](ley_collector) set along one feels it like any other. Totems do not bend them.

They stay while the star stands, through saving and unloaded chunks. Break the heart or any of its six totems and all six come down at once; make the star whole again and they rise within two seconds.
Only **Answered** totems sing (see [Keeping](keeping)), and a working heart keeps its own six answered. A steady redstone signal stills it.
